Read me: 'WO Board and Tech View Feature Squad – Test cases with changed behaviour (14 Oct 2026)
'For Bilal Muzamil, who owns every test case in this suite.

'We checked all 258 live test cases in the WO Board and Tech View folder against every source as of today: the spec (now version 48, 12 Oct), the Review Decisions page, all comments, the SV-10043 tickets, the tech plan, the Slack channel and the design you shared today. Nothing was changed in TestRail.

'Only test cases whose expected behaviour really changed are listed, so that a tester following them today would pass a build that still works the old way, or fail a correct one. Word-only changes, and cases Vladimir already brought up to date (C96923, C368131), are left out.
'Possible tests waiting on a product decision
'What changed in the spec since 7 Oct

'Six changes, all by Chris Ward. 8 Oct (v43): the "no results" message in Tech View and Board View now matches the List, with exact words. 9 Oct (v44): a pinned technician removed from this location gets no column. 12 Oct (v45): Assigned to me stays on through a location change. 12 Oct (v46): a line held only through a Schedule shift follows the new lead. 12 Oct (v47): a shift that covers every line counts as a whole-work-order shift. 12 Oct (v48): Imported work orders open only in List, with two exact tooltips.

'The design shared on 14 Oct adds a "Work order preview" panel that opens when you click a List row. The spec says the List is unchanged, so this is a question for Chris (question 9); no test case changes until he answers.
